nodeReferencePolicy: Each original Graph node is stored once, referenced by its unchanged ID; not a newly minted fact.
periodContract: [start,endExclusive); all comparisons are adjacent NON_SIMULTANEOUS_COMPARISON. Each independent typed receipt retains its own exact window.
signaturePolicy: Exclude only relation ID and period-specific provenance from semantic comparison; compare actual relation value, producer, participant identities, direction and domains. Keep all IDs, windows, roots and original Comparator observations separately.
uncertaintyPolicy: F March/September and Ranged March are withheld for actual unknown-hour element relations. Earlier August conditional Dayun segments remain recorded, not chosen as August last; September uses the actual confirmed last segment.
